purpose: Compact machine-readable knowledge authority for AI development, API planning, developer documentation and FAQ generation. Repository-owned; chat memory is never authority.

identity.product_summary: Music discovery, canonical metadata, provenance, provider evidence and legal listening or viewing destinations.

engineering_defaults.verification: GitHub Auto Closure plus accepted-main CI
engineering_defaults.dependency_policy: Laravel first-party, then mature documented package, then product-specific custom code
engineering_defaults.technology_policy: Fresh technology/package decisions require compatibility evidence, overlap/reuse/retirement analysis and net ROI; novelty alone is not adoption evidence.
engineering_defaults.external_ai_policy: Repository authority outranks MCP/provider skills and agent-local memory; official provider MCPs are evaluated before custom bridges only when the provider is relevant to an active use case.
engineering_defaults.documentation_policy: Active knowledge is organized by semantic owner. Legacy stage documents are consolidation inputs and are retired after durable semantics and consumers are migrated.

domain_boundaries.canonical_identity: SongChart owns canonical music identity and reconciliation semantics.
domain_boundaries.provider_taxonomy: SongChart owns provider category, role, capability and readiness vocabulary; providers supply evidence and provider-native operational state.
domain_boundaries.authorization: Laravel Gates remain authorization enforcement unless a new accepted runtime permission requirement proves otherwise.
domain_boundaries.audit: Privileged mutations emit audit evidence at the governed use-case boundary.
domain_boundaries.security: Framework/platform controls own generic web security; custom security remains only for product-specific trust boundaries.

delivery_model.normal_path: bounded branch -> Draft PR -> Auto PREPARE -> Auto CHECK -> browser smoke when applicable -> canonical CLOSE -> Auto Ready -> human Merge -> accepted-main CI

project_intelligence.rule: Serve latest completed snapshot and expose staleness; rebuild only through explicit/background refresh.

ai_working_rules: Read generated project-context.json and live ai status before relying on conversation context for volatile facts.
Use current repository authorities over historical stage documents.
Use MCP governance and external-system registry before connecting or relying on external provider tooling.
When a relevant provider offers an official MCP, evaluate that official integration before custom MCP code, but reject duplicate/low-value tool surfaces.
Do not install provider MCPs automatically or commit their credentials.
Treat legacy STAGE_* files as migration inputs; use documentation-consolidation-contract.json to extract durable semantics and retire redundant files.
Exact retired historical text is recovered from Git/PR history; active AI orientation must not depend on old stage files.
Do not add a new verifier when an existing contract/Pest Architecture test can own the invariant.
Record deferred technology decisions in the watchlist/owning contract rather than only in chat.
